basic_info.description: 6424 California St is a well-maintained three-unit apartment building located in the Richmond District. The unit mix consists of a full floor 3 bedroom 2 bath flat, a 2 bedroom 1 bath unit and a 1 bedroom 1 bath unit. The property features garage parking, storage, a shared backyard, flexible layouts and a coin operated washer and dryer. Steps from the Presidio, Golden Gate Park, China Beach, and Clement Street shops, this location is ideal for both investors and owner-occupants.
